scope: Read-only local React demo in the existing Chrome acceptance tab
method: Record browser rendering metrics, send one Control+plus key through the browser-tab API, then record metrics again. No CSS, DOM, viewport override, or device-scale emulation was applied.
action: Control+plus once through the tab input API
reason: The key action produced no browser-zoom metric change. The connected browser API exposes page input and a viewport override, but no browser-chrome zoom control; therefore 200% zoom was not measured or inferred.
